recommendation: Preserve instruction work score; add optional instructions+cycles recording with per-event full-running/unscaled checks, raw output and collector event identity; expose separate cycle ratio, repeatability and targeted-timing warning. Validate prospectively against quiet nightly timings before any gate policy change.
already_available: Generic metric summaries/report JSON; dynamic allocation/copy/shared-RC totals, Callgrind memory/atomic counts and static Core/native diagnostics. Static sites do not measure hotness.
limits: Cycles depend on cache state, SMT contention, frequency and scheduling; current context identity excludes transient frequency/load.
Absent/unstable cycles must be unavailable or uncertain, never passed.
Interleave baseline/candidate; preselect controls, improvements and regressions across families and hold out commits/families.
Current power-law model cannot represent flat instructions with slower execution; six selected historical cases are insufficient training or validation.
Historical eight-event perf review discarded running percentages and permits scaling; retrospective ratios illustrate value but do not validate a proxy.
